schutzenberger_mechanism_lt_1e-1000.held_finding: Neither is derived in the text; on p.73 he says the cycle numbers are quoted from other speakers

notes: Milton's figure is held only as Day's unattributed relay (1 in 10^65, no length, function or fold); the book is not held, so whether Milton derives it is unknown, and the held text gives no derivation. Claim file D8's candidate 50-mer reading (20^-50 = 10^-65.05) fits the number but no source states it. Schützenberger's < 10^-1000 (p.75) and < 10^-100 (p.76) come with no derivation in the volume as quoted; they concern a hypothetical class of programs (claim file D5a, external untestable).
